product.title: Tokyo Metropolis

description.text: In Tokyo, this small-group photography walk starts at the Shinbashi Station steam locomotive and moves through Shiodome Siosite, Ginza alleys, and the Tokyo International Forum. A local photographer covers composition and technical pacing for a group capped at six, with the published duration at two hours 30 minutes. The route stays on steel-and-glass towers and interior lines rather than a shrine-and-temple walking loop. No hotel pickup is listed. The format suits visitors who want guided architectural shooting without assembling a Shimbashi-to-Ginza route independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Tokyo, and the itinerary stays on Shiodome, Ginza, and the Tokyo International Forum that shape this workshop rather than a Mount Fuji day.

highlights: Small-group photography walk limited to six
Shiodome skyscraper and Ginza alley compositions
Local photographer instruction for novices and advanced shooters
